About.title: About
About.lead: An assistant that helps students choose next term's courses, with a clear line between what rules decide and what AI suggests.
how: The system reads the transcript text and matches course codes against the department's study plan. You then review and correct the result.
Fixed rules decide which courses are open to you: prerequisites, courses offered this term, and credit-hour limits for your GPA.
The AI chooses only from those courses, ranks them and explains its choice. Its output is checked against the rules again, and if it is unreachable the rules do the ranking.
About.privacy: The transcript is read in memory and is not saved on the server. For the schedule, only course codes, their grades and the cumulative GPA are sent to the AI model. If the transcript's layout does not match the rules, only its course lines are sent to be read, after removing any line with a name, ID or contact detail and masking long numbers.
About.limits: Reading a transcript depends on the layout of the PDF, which is why the result is shown for review before anything is suggested. Suggestions are advisory; your academic advisor and the official registration system have the final say.
